newsitem.title: POLAND: Westa receiver seeks Prochnik manager.
newsitem.headline: Westa receiver seeks Prochnik manager.

text.p: The receiver of failed insurance firm Westa is seeking a financial institution to manage the latter's 25-percent stake in garment maker Prochnik SA and later sell it, the receiver said on Friday.
"Negotiations are underway to find a financial institution that would in my name manage that block of shares and sell it," Dorota Brzezinska-Grabarczyk, who represents Westa creditors, told Reuters.
She said next week specific proposals would be submitted and that a firm would be chosen by the end of the month.
Brzezinski-Grabarczyk would not disclose which institutions were interested in managing the Prochnik shares.

The daily Gazeta Wyborcza said on Friday that National Investment Fund No. 6 in Poland's mass privatisation scheme as well as units of Bank Handlowy SA and Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) were interested.
